gloss: rocky area; rocky place; rocky terrain

definitions.gloss: rocky area; rocky place; rocky terrain
definitions.explanation: An area of ground, coastline, or mountain that is covered with large rocks or rock formations. Often used in the context of climbing, hiking, or fishing.

examples.japanese: {岩場|いわば}で{釣|つ}りをした。
examples.english: I fished from the rocky area.

examples.japanese: {岩場|いわば}は{滑|すべ}りやすいので{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: The rocky area is slippery, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}な{岩場|いわば}を{登|のぼ}るには{専門|せんもん}の{道具|どうぐ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Climbing steep rocky terrain requires specialized equipment.

notes:
Compound of {岩|いわ} (rock) + {場|ば} (place), with {場|ば} voicing to ば in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩場|いわば}を{登|のぼ}る: to climb a rocky area
- {岩場|いわば}で{釣|つ}りをする: to fish from rocks
- {険|けわ}しい{岩場|いわば}: steep rocky terrain
- {岩場|いわば}に{囲|かこ}まれた{海岸|かいがん}: rocky coastline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {岩肌|いわはだ}: rock face — the exposed surface of a rock, not an area
- {岩礁|がんしょう}: reef; rocky shoal — submerged or partially submerged rocks in the sea
- {磯|いそ}: rocky beach — specifically a rocky shoreline
